title: arenaria serpyllifolia subsp. tenuior
intro: Arenaria serpyllifolia subsp. tenuior, commonly known as thin sea pink or lesser sea spurrey, is a plant species within the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Arenaria serpyllifolia subsp. tenuior include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and possibly anti-diabetic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
